title: Accurate AI security review token accounting and failures
description: Security reviews use native OpenAI Responses requests and supported protocols for Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek and local model endpoints. The broker reserves the bounded output requested and settles provider-reported usage instead of charging every call the maximum reservation. Explicit rejected requests release unused reservations; uncertain outcomes remain conservatively bounded. Access failures, rate limits, rejected requests and unavailable models have distinct reasons instead of being presented as token-limit exhaustion. Source-only restrictions and configured budgets remain enforced.
upgrade: Recreate matching API and worker services. Interrupted reviews are not resumed; check the selected model connection and start a new review after active work has finished.
